englishNaturalness.evidence: The classmate has the wrong item; correcting the request resolves an explicit problem. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

transferQuality.evidence: The listening answer only claims an apology and corrected noun, not an unseen physical action. A05 switches the desired object. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: The classmate has the wrong item; correcting the request resolves an explicit problem. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
